name: Thotar
summary: In Razor Hill, Thotar prepares young Horde hunters for Durotar’s wilds. Orcs and trolls come to him after leaving the Valley of Trials to learn tracking and beast taming.

sections.title: A Mentor in Razor Hill
sections.body: Thotar trains Horde hunters in Razor Hill for the wilderness of Durotar. After learning the basics in the Valley of Trials, new recruits come to him to face more dangerous predators. He teaches marksmanship and the respect needed to live alongside and direct Kalimdor’s deadliest creatures. Orcs have passed these traditions down through generations.

sections.title: Taming the Wilds
sections.body: Thotar sends young hunters into arid canyons to learn the ancient art of taming beasts. There, they calm and bond with native creatures, from venomous scorpids and armored surf crawlers to cunning boars. His lessons teach Horde trackers to build a bond with nature instead of relying on force.

faq.answer: Thotar trains hunters in Razor Hill. He teaches traditional wilderness lore, marksmanship, and beast taming.
Thotar can be found in Razor Hill, the Horde settlement in central Durotar, just north of the Valley of Trials.
Thotar teaches hunting and tracking traditions passed down through generations of orcs. His lessons cover weapon mastery, wilderness survival, and patient bonds with animal companions.
Thotar trains hunters aligned with the Horde who come to Razor Hill. He mentors Darkspear trolls and wandering tauren passing through Durotar.

faq.q: What tasks does Thotar give to young hunters?
aliases: what does thotar send you to do
faq.answer: Thotar sends novice hunters to track native Durotar wildlife, including boars, surf crawlers, and scorpids. They use a taming rod to earn the beasts’ trust and obedience.

faq.q: Why is beast taming so important in his training?
faq.answer: A beast companion can help a Horde hunter survive in battle and in the wild. Thotar teaches hunters to bond with their beasts so they become loyal defenders of the Horde.

angles.text: As a Horde hunter, you learn beast taming rites and wilderness skills after leaving the starter valleys.
As an orc, you follow Thotar’s traditional hunting customs and ancestral respect for tracking and beast companionship.
As a Darkspear hunter leaving Sen’jin Village, you learn Horde survival skills for Durotar’s dangers.
As a member of the Horde, you can learn from Thotar in Razor Hill to patrol Durotar’s borders with sharp eyes and a well-bonded combat beast.
